description.fun: Salandit is a sneaky lizard that breathes out a sweet-smelling poison gas made by burning its body fluids, which makes foes dizzy and lures in Bug Pokémon to eat. Females also give off pheromones that attract males of every species, humans included, and males hand their food over to females, leaving themselves too malnourished to evolve. It struggles against Spinda, though: you can't unbalance something that's already off balance.
description.guide: Salandit is a Poison- and Fire-type salamander Pokémon from Alola. It releases toxic, sweet-smelling gas and unbalances opponents with cunning tricks. Only females evolve, becoming Salazzle at level 33.
description.tagline: A sly fire lizard whose sweet poison gas leaves foes dizzy

description.fun: Salazzle is a fiery salamander queen that lives deep in caves surrounded by male Salandit, drawn in by the pheromones in its sweet poison gas. It makes them bring it food and punishes slackers with flaming slaps, and rival Salazzle compete over who can gather the most. Diluted, its gas can even be made into perfume.
description.guide: Salazzle is a Poison- and Fire-type Pokémon that evolves from female Salandit, and it is female-only. Its sweet pheromone gas attracts male Salandit, which serve it. In Alola, a Totem Salazzle guards Kiawe's trial at Wela Volcano Park.
description.tagline: A fire lizard queen with a cave full of devoted servants

note.text: Only female Salandit evolve. Males give their food to females and end up too malnourished to evolve, which is why every Salazzle is female.
